name: Konan Yako
source:
Having a very strong passion for theater, Yako trains the people she views to possess talent with harsh discipline, which is why [url=/c98281]Chika[/url] hates her. She gives off an unapproachable aura due to her rude and belligerent way of talking.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180927080054/http://kimisaki.happyelements.co.jp/charactor/]archived official website[/url]]
